'''Tern Ashandrik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and criminal who was active during the [[Rebellion era]].

==Personality and traits==
Ashandrik was tall and muscular, with dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a well-trimmed goatee. He favored black and crimson-[[Color/Legends|colored]] clothes or his personalized [[Smasher Armor]]. Ashandrik was arrogant and smug, looking down on others who he believed were inferior to him. He operated under the theory that one only got things in life by taking them at gunpoint. He firmly believed that he would surpass [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in terms of success as a bounty hunter.

==Equipment==
Ashandrik operated out of a modified [[MRX-BR Pacifier]] called the [[Arbalest (MRX-BR Pacifier)|''Arbalest'']]. He carried a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]] as a sidearm, but favoured a [[:VES-700 Pulse Rifle|Pulse Rifle]] in combat.
